description_en: Supports structured extraction of fields such as name, license number, nationality, address, initial issue date, approved vehicle type, and validity period from a driver's license
description_zh: 支持对驾驶证上的姓名、证号、国籍、住址、初次领证日期、准驾类型、有效期等字段进行结构化提取
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-driving-license --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB18sTuNSzqK1RjSZPxXXc4tVXa-629-416.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeDrivingLicense

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
* 本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:

* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
